snippet.title: Outlaws of the Lost Dynasty, 1995 -Sega Saturn Japanese Import Gameplay
snippet.description:
An early 2D beat em up for the Saturn, this didn't make it over here for us Europeans which is a damn shame since it's an absolute blast. 
Check my review of the game over at https://saturnimportchannel.wordpress.com
